title: Provisioning and invite API for other products' entitlements and memberships
description: From the Papyrus side (gap 5 in the Papyrus gap audit). Not blocking p.apyr.us sign-in, so no urgency, but today nobody can grant a Papyrus site or Cyclotron Lab access through the API: account creation grants only the caller's own product, nothing adds or disables another product's entitlement, membership changes need an already-enrolled Person UUID (no invite by email), and operator access is read-only. Needed: an admin write path for entitlements and an invite-by-email membership flow. Prospectus owns the design. Raised by the Papyrus Prospectus-integration thread; decision on priority is Ryan's.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-31 (Billing planner): the operator side of this (create an account for a client, grant products, invite the owner) is now a story under this epic filed by the billing plan; invite-by-email stays shared with kanbus-b2ddb4.
